name: Sherlock
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve brown checked deerstalker/cape coat with red lining, black waistcoat/trousers, red tie, short locs, beard, pipe, magnifier and gold watch chain. Review lens distortion confined to the lens, continuous watch transformation, no invented words/numerals, and title spelling.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult dark-skinned detective with short dark locs, neatly trimmed beard, brown checked deerstalker and long matching cape coat with red lining, black three-piece suit, white collar, red tie, black gloves, gold watch chain and polished two-tone shoes. Preserve his curved pipe and gold-rimmed magnifying glass. The pocket watch comes from the existing waistcoat chain.
0–1.2s: full-body composed detective. He holds the magnifier near his eye and notices one taut crimson thread crossing in front of his shoe. Sharp lens close-up: the tiny thread and a brass catch are hugely magnified INSIDE the round glass only. He gives an almost imperceptible knowing smile and flips open his pocket watch with the free hand.
1.2–3.2s: whip-pullback reveals the watch unfolding into a colossal open clockwork snare thirty feet away, a huge round brass case with interlocking gears and a hinged lid. Pure cyan outside the finite machine. A gigantic black chess KNIGHT piece, a carved horse-head object with no crown, charges through the open case along the red thread. Sherlock calmly turns his small watch stem; the exact moment the chess base touches the thread, the trap engages. No chessboard or room.
3.2–4.8s: rush into the mechanism for a spectacular cascade: three brass catches fire in sequence, gears rotate, thick metal arms snap inward and the enormous lid SLAMS around the chess piece. One huge bounded ivory/crimson compression star and a hard impact pause. The trapped object and case telescope rapidly down into a normal closed pocket watch, which zips along its chain back to his waiting glove. One watch throughout, no duplicate character.
4.8–6s: snap close-up of his calm face as the closed watch clicks into his palm. Exact title STAKEOUT slams across the lower composition in the established comic style. His expression says he arranged every step in advance.
6–8s: complete hero pose on cyan, watch tucked away, coat hem settling. He raises the magnifier again; one eye briefly appears comically enormous only through the glass. He lowers it with an unimpressed eyebrow and holds. SFX: watch click, stretched-thread twang, accelerating gear ratchets, three spring catches, dominant heavy lid CLANG, chain zip, title slam and tiny magnifier squeak. No speech, music, extra words, clock numerals or background panels.

name: Sports Prodigy
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve athletic build, high dark ponytail with colored beads, blue-lensed goggles, white/blue/yellow uniform, black leggings and blue/yellow sneakers. Cyan goggles and blue accents may need masking in engine QA; do not recolor. Review one ball, clean handoffs, three connected dunk impacts and no court/scenery.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact athletic adult brown-skinned woman with amber eyes, huge dark high ponytail with blue/gold beads, blue-lensed sports goggles resting on her head, white basketball top with blue/gold trim, royal-blue shorts, black leggings with gold trim, and white/blue/gold high-top sneakers. Preserve her orange basketball. Keep all costume colors, and use warm ivory/orange action effects rather than cyan glow.
0–1.2s: full-body athletic stance on a single small isolated red springboard disc suspended on cyan. One lightning-fast low crossover bounce on that disc, then she tosses the SAME basketball straight upward and compresses into a deep launch crouch. Camera follows the ball for an instant before her explosive jump blasts the disc down and away with a bounded ivory shock ring.
1.2–3.2s: camera rockets upward and pulls far back to reveal THREE separate regulation-sized orange hoops and their small charcoal backboards stacked vertically across fifty feet of empty cyan. She overtakes her own rising ball, catches it one-handed above the highest hoop, then swings through a huge athletic aerial 360, ball passing once between her bent knees. Keep exactly one character and one ball, clean anatomy and obvious continuous trajectory.
3.2–4.8s: her rotation ends in a ferocious downward DUNK. She drives the ball through the highest hoop, follows its plunge through the middle hoop, then hammers it through the final hoop in one escalating three-hit cascade. Each hoop bends with a sharp contact hold, the three compact backboards kick away as finite angular pieces, and the last hit releases a massive bounded ivory/orange impact star. Huge travel, real contact, a decisive final slam; no court, crowd, scoreboard or full-frame flash.
4.8–6s: camera whip-zooms to her confident face as she catches the rebounding ball on one fingertip and spins it. Exact title NEXT UP slams below her shoulders with a deep gym-impact boom. Goggles remain on her head and face stays unobstructed.
6–8s: pull back to her complete swaggering pose, spinning ball in one hand, other hand brushing her ponytail back. A tiny bent hoop fragment drops past her shoulder; without looking she heel-flicks it away and continues the ball spin. SFX: crisp crossover thump and shoe squeak, explosive springboard release, rising rush, three massive descending rim CLANGS with the third largest, title slam, ball spin flutter and tiny metal ting. No crowd, music or dialogue.

name: Squabble House Manager
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve muscular build, hairnet, goatee, white shirt, black branded apron/gloves, yellow trousers, towel, boots and breakfast plate. Existing printed uniform/tattoo details remain, no added logos. Review plate continuity, intact food, one-handed chair contact and clear full-body end.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact massively muscular adult dark-skinned manager, close hair under white hairnet, short goatee, small gold earring, white collared shirt, black printed apron, black gloves, bright yellow trousers, striped kitchen towel and black work boots. Preserve the source uniform lettering as fixed costume detail. He balances the original oval breakfast plate of waffle, eggs, bacon and hash browns in his left hand. His right hand is free.
0–0.7s: full-body low angle. He levels a warning finger with his free right hand while holding the breakfast platter perfectly horizontal. The small butter pat lifts a few inches off the waffle from a tiny wrist toss. A red diner chair flies toward him from deep cyan, followed by two metal stools.
0.7–2.5s: camera sweeps around his massive shoulder as he ducks beneath the chair, rolls his right elbow under its seat and detonates upward with a full-body uppercut using that same forearm. The chair shoots thirty feet upward and backward, smashing through both incoming stools in one tremendous escalating furniture chain collision. Large bounded ivory/orange contact stars, a short dominant impact hold, stools tumbling away in readable arcs. His left arm keeps the entire breakfast level throughout, no food spills and no human opponent.
2.5–3.5s: snap back toward his stern face and untouched plate as the exact title HOME ADVANTAGE slams below his chest with a huge diner-tray clang. His hairnet and apron snap from the recoil; preserve the hat, build and face. Every unoccupied area remains cyan; no restaurant, floor or tables.
3.5–5s: whole-character composition. The SAME butter pat falls precisely back onto the center of the waffle. He catches the final descending bent chair leg between two right-hand fingers, tosses it aside without a glance, and extends the immaculate breakfast toward camera with an expression that says service continues. SFX: small plate swish, three incoming furniture whistles, huge uppercut WHAM and cascading metallic crashes, title slam, soft butter plop and tiny chair-leg rattle. No voice, music or added captions.

name: Squabble House Worker — Female
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve curly bun, black/yellow visor, gold hoops, white blouse, black apron/trousers, striped towel, boots, breakfast tray and glass coffee pot. Review one continuous coffee arc, finite steam and ice, pot/tray hand continuity and transparency/keying around glass.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned server with dark curly hair in a high bun, black visor with existing yellow checker marks, gold hoop earrings, white short-sleeve blouse, black apron and trousers, striped white/yellow towel and black work boots. Preserve the full breakfast tray overhead in her left hand and round glass coffee pot with black handle in her right. She stays poised and athletic.
0–0.7s: full-body pose with loaded tray perfectly balanced overhead. Ahead floats one oversized white ceramic mug imprisoned in jagged pale-lavender ice, with three small orange flame tongues licking its outer rim. She sights the mug, flicks her wrist and launches a single strong arc of dark brown coffee from the pot.
0.7–2.5s: camera rides beside that arc and pulls far back as it grows into an enormous sweeping coffee waterfall over twenty feet of empty cyan. She slides through the air underneath it in a low graceful split stance, breakfast still level. The ribbon curls around the trapped mug once, then crashes through its ice shell with one huge bounded ivory/amber impact burst. Lavender ice shards fling outward and the flame tongues snuff simultaneously into three small separate cream puffs. This is an extravagant restoration move: the mug stays intact and emerges warm and spotless. No opaque steam wall, no cyan ice and no surrounding diner.
2.5–3.5s: the coffee ribbon tightens into one perfect final pour into the restored mug, then breaks cleanly. Camera whips back to her face as exact title FRESH POT slams beneath her shoulders with a sharp tray-clang impact. Loaded left-hand tray remains horizontal and undisturbed, right hand retains the original pot.
3.5–5s: clear complete hero composition. The giant mug gently shrinks to normal size and glides onto her raised breakfast tray. She stops it neatly with one fingertip under the tray, pours one last precise drop with her right hand, and flashes a knowing sideways smile. Small bounded cream steam curls above the cup, all backing pure cyan. SFX: coffee-pot swish, accelerating liquid rush, huge ice-breaking splash with simultaneous flame hiss, precise pour, title impact, gentle mug clink and one final drip. No speech or music. Author clean five-second action rather than speeding playback.
